units.source_text: 我望着这副面孔，焦灼地度过这段时间。

en.t: I spent that time staring at this face, consumed by anxiety.

units.source_text: 我有点沮丧，甚至考虑过别烧洗澡水了，

en.t: I felt somewhat disheartened, and even thought of not having the bathwater heated,

units.source_text: 她等着我谈她的终身大事呢，

en.t: since she was waiting for me to discuss the great matter of her future,

units.source_text: 我干脆把她撂下，就这样回东京去算了。

en.t: I thought I might as well leave her behind and go back to Tokyo just like that.

units.source_text: 我向女佣打听过两三次可以洗澡不，

en.t: I asked the maid two or three times whether I could take a bath,

units.source_text: 可又害怕洗澡水烧热了。

en.t: but at the same time I was afraid the bathwater would be heated.
